specs.title: Memory Tier (DRAM Cache Pool)

drifted.spec_text: Pool is divided into 16 independent shards.
drifted.actual: Single RwLock<Pool> with one FreeList and one HashMap; no shards.

drifted.spec_text: Each shard has its own Mutex-protected allocator and slot map.
drifted.actual: One allocator + slot map under a single RwLock.

drifted.spec_text: evict_next() cycles through shards via atomic counter (round-robin).
drifted.actual: evict_next delegates to ep.identify_next_to_evict; no evict_counter field.

drifted.spec_text: evict_next_for_key() evicts from the same shard as the target key.
drifted.actual: key parameter ignored (_key); pure alias for evict_next().
Single call ep.get_eviction_candidates(pool_id, n); no per-shard sampling.

drifted.spec_text: Interface doc asserts Creusot-verified P1-P10 and shard index < 16 / cycles through all 16 shards.
drifted.actual: No proofs exist and no shards exist; doc comments are stale and misleading.

not_implemented: SC-8 (10 Creusot properties / 21 verification conditions) - no proof artifacts under components/memory-tier/verif/
16-way sharded allocator and slot map (FR-005/006/007, NFR-002)
